description: Continuous evaluation of the multi-agent delivery workflow itself — not only product code. Fine-tune weights, SLOs, and gap closeouts here.

fail_closed_if: critics missing provider fields when claiming multi-model

rows.gap: No automatic link to GitHub/Linear issues unless human pastes IDs
No live stakeholder ping; orchestrator pauses are manual
Does not auto-open ADRs; human promotes decisions
No calendar/capacity model; opportunity_cost is qualitative
Multi-shard parallel execute not fully automated
Does not replace human PR review or oya-ci-required
No live GH status polling in harness v1
No pager integration; memory is local files only
Skill promotion to default packs is human-gated

known_failures.symptom: .grok kit is local or side-branch only; origin/dev has zero tracked kit files
known_failures.impact: Agents cannot share multi-model process; worktrees and CI agents have no mm-role/mm-drive
known_failures.close_gap: Land kit PR to dev excluding mm-runs/memory; optional preflight require_kit_on_base

known_failures.symptom: Dual-critic APPROVE packets from same-provider session subagents presented as multi-model
known_failures.impact: False independence; merge-check could clear on non-adversarial reviews
known_failures.close_gap: Packet independence+provider fields; drive merge_policy admit only cross_model; default critics via mm-role

known_failures.symptom: Isolated worktree has no .grok/ so mm-* cannot run
known_failures.impact: Forces Grok-only bypass of multi-model kit
known_failures.close_gap: mm-bootstrap into worktree at lane start; fail multi-model claims without kit bins

known_failures.symptom: Repeated tip pushes cancel in-flight oya-ci-required
known_failures.impact: Wasted runner time; delayed signal; agent thrash
known_failures.close_gap: drive.v1 push_budget; hold doc-only while CI in_progress; armed re-poll

known_failures.symptom: PR babysit via ad-hoc subagents without mm-drive ledger/tick
known_failures.impact: No process journal; stop-hook and class machine unused
known_failures.close_gap: Outer loop is mm-drive status|tick|merge-check; journal mm-runs/_ledger

known_failures.symptom: mm-evaluate static scores A while runtime process fails kit use
known_failures.impact: Teams trust structure score as delivery health
known_failures.close_gap: mm-evaluate run requires drive ledger + dual-critic independence; never claim process-healthy from static alone

known_failures.symptom: Product code lands without red_test_report proof or tests are added after implementation only
known_failures.close_gap: pipeline implement_loop + admit_rules require_red_test_proof_before_implement; EXECUTOR requires_red_test_proof

known_failures.symptom: Suite greened by skip/ignore/delete/weaken of failing tests
known_failures.impact: CI green without behavior; merge of broken product
known_failures.close_gap: FALSE_GREEN_SCAN harness stage + fail_closed checks in false_green_scan.v1

known_failures.symptom: Ship after first green without simplify/harden or review
known_failures.close_gap: SIMPLIFY and HARDEN stages mandatory with green re-run; admit_rules require them or explicit waiver

known_failures.symptom: Most multi-model stages run serial; only dual critics parallel in Rhai
known_failures.impact: Wall clock grows linearly with slices
known_failures.close_gap: Path-disjoint executor shards + parallel critic spawn in mm-pipeline; measure parallel_efficiency

known_failures.symptom: Rhai agents inherit session model; multi-model needs mm-role
known_failures.close_gap: Optional mm-pipeline role bridge from workflow handoff artifacts; default dual CRITIC via mm-role

known_failures.symptom: Session project may be diverged from origin/dev
Rhai embeds lens text; packs JSON can drift from script
known_failures.impact: Fine-tune packs without updating workflow → critics wrong
known_failures.close_gap: Generate critic prefix via mm-lens-prompt in docs; later inject from host

known_failures.symptom: Does not watch oya-ci-required on PR
known_failures.close_gap: Optional gh status check stage; never replace required context

known_failures.symptom: Tips/skills written but packs not auto-updated
known_failures.close_gap: After 2 KPI repeats, human PR to stage-lens-packs or role system prompts
